# Jevon Perra (jevonperra.com)

> Personal site of Jevon Perra: author, host of the Awake with Jevon podcast, YouTube creator, and California-licensed mortgage broker based in Fountain Valley, California. He writes and talks about spiritual awakening, letting go, the ego, A Course in Miracles and the Law of One.

## Key facts
- Name: Jevon Perra (pronounced je-VAHN)
- Location: Fountain Valley, Orange County, California
- Describes himself as: Conscious, an author, a householder, a Home Loan lender, a God & people lover (same thing)
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@jevonperra
- Podcast: Awake With Jevon: Discovering Guides That Point The Way (https://open.spotify.com/show/1TXFYxA3JNvPQcTYseowRd)
- Books (Amazon author page https://www.amazon.com/stores/Jevon-Perra/author/B081JSYY28/allbooks): Zombai: The Spark; The Choice: Wake Up. Embody Down. (Living the Law of One); Life Experiment: 8 Tactics To Challenge Reality To Create A New One (first published as Experiment); The Captain: A Tale of Self-Discovery, Awakening and the Hidden Atlantis
- Lending: licensed mortgage broker (CA DRE #01716773, NMLS #1006038) with My Bridge Loans Corporation (NMLS #2869596). Bridge loans at https://mybridge.loans; California home loans at https://perraloans.com
- Background: grew up working on his family's real estate job sites in Southern California; Missouri Southern State University; trained leaders in human behavior and communication at Boeing, Kaiser Permanente and Microsoft; coaching, negotiation and Fierce Conversations certifications; Calvary Chapel School of Ministry; former pastor and church planter; mortgage lender since 2004
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jevonperra/
